results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_draw_pixel_shader_pass
results.evidence: Gated by master-disable DAT_006893e4, per-feature flag DAT_006893fa and pixel-shader capability check (DAT_007c118c >= 0xffff0101, i.e. D3DPS_VERSION(1,1)); selects a technique index (0x20/0x21/0x22) into the DAT_0069d410 table, binds textures via chimera__rasterizer_set_texture_direct_d3dx/FUN_00518860 and draws with chimera__rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices2.
results.summary: Draws one extra shader_environment sub-pass looked up from a per-technique table, when the device's pixel-shader capability and per-feature flag allow it.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_set_render_states_a
results.evidence: Sets IDirect3DDevice9 render-states (0x16,0xa8,0x1b,0x13,0x14,0xab,0xf,7,0x17,0xe,0x1c) and texture-stage states for stages 0-2 when DAT_006893e4==0, DAT_006893f8!=0, DAT_006893fa!=0 and DAT_0069c67c==0; unconditionally stores DAT_0071d1d0 = &DAT_0069d890 (a technique table pointer read back by 0x520910/0x520970).
results.summary: Configures fixed-function multitexture render/texture-stage states for one shader_environment technique variant and records the active technique table pointer.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_set_active
results.evidence: Checks the same capability flags plus DAT_0071d1d0 (the table set by 0x520790) being non-null with a non-zero first entry; toggles DAT_006e0a0c between 0/1 based on a caller-supplied EAX flag, calling FUN_005186c0(0) when clearing it.
results.summary: Enables or disables the shader_environment technique selected by 0x520790 based on a caller-supplied flag.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_draw_pass_a
results.evidence: Same capability gating as 0x520790/0x520910; reads object floats at offsets 0x2f4/0x2f8/0x2d4 as enable thresholds, builds a constant block via FUN_00540060, uploads it (device vtable+0x178) and iterates the DAT_0071d1d0 interface's Begin/DrawPrimitive/End (vtable+0x100/0x104/0x108) calling chimera__rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices2 per part.
results.summary: Draws the shader_environment technique enabled by 0x520910 across all parts of an object, uploading per-part shader constants.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_set_render_states_b
results.evidence: Same shape as 0x520790 but gated on DAT_006893f9 && DAT_007c1224 && (short)DAT_007c1220==1, and configures 4 texture stages (0-3) with a different set of texture-stage-state constants.
results.summary: Configures fixed-function multitexture render/texture-stage states for another shader_environment technique variant selected by tag flags.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_draw_pass_b
results.evidence: Mirrors 0x5202f0's structure (DAT_0069d410 technique table lookup, chimera__rasterizer_set_texture_direct_d3dx, chimera__rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices) but is gated by DAT_006893f9/DAT_007c1224/DAT_007c1220==1 and an object flag byte at offset 0x2d0 bit 0.
results.summary: Draws the shader_environment technique variant selected for the DAT_006893f9 feature path, structurally identical to 0x5202f0 but with a different capability/flag gate.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_set_render_states_c
results.evidence: Gated by DAT_006893f6 && DAT_007c118c > 0xffff0103; sets an extended render/texture-stage-state block across stages 0-3 that additionally touches stage state 0x18, unlike the sibling setup functions.
results.summary: Configures fixed-function render/texture-stage states for a higher pixel-shader-tier shader_environment technique variant.

results.name: rasterizer_light_compute_falloff_frame
results.evidence: Reads a per-light record from DAT_007c1484+in_EAX*0xe (checking a cookie/gel shader index at +0x70/+0x88), computes a cross product plus normalized basis via vector3d_cross_product/vector3d_normalize_with_length, then stores position, inverse-radius and negated axis terms into the DAT_006e0a10.. block consumed by 0x521750/0x521900.
results.summary: Builds the direction/inverse-falloff constant block (position, radius, normalized axes) for the light indexed by in_EAX, feeding the dynamic-light draw pass.

results.name: rasterizer_light_prepare
results.evidence: Gated by DAT_006893f6 && DAT_007c118c > 0xffff0103; branches on whether the indexed light record (DAT_007c1484 table, offsets 0x70/0x88) has a valid cookie/gel shader to either call FUN_005215b0's cookie path or fill a default falloff constant block directly, and computes the light's NTSC luminance (0.299/0.587/0.114 weights) into DAT_0071d1d8.
results.summary: Prepares the shader constants (cookie texture or plain falloff) and luminance value for one dynamic light, ready for the light draw pass.

results.name: rasterizer_light_draw_pass
results.evidence: Structurally identical to 0x5202f0/0x520e50 (DAT_0069d910/0x930 technique table lookup, per-part draw loop via chimera__rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices) but scales the drawn color by _DAT_0071d1d8 (the luminance computed in 0x521750) and object float at offset 0x290.
results.summary: Renders the dynamic-light contribution pass over an object's parts, modulated by the light's luminance and cookie texture prepared in 0x521750.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_set_render_states_d
results.evidence: Gated by DAT_006893f7 && DAT_0069c67c==0 && DAT_007c118c > 0xffff0103; sets an extended render/texture-stage-state block across stages 0-3, structurally identical to 0x5212d0 but keyed off a different capability flag.
results.summary: Configures fixed-function render/texture-stage states for another higher-tier shader_environment technique variant.

results.name: rasterizer_light_draw_pass_extended
results.evidence: Gated by DAT_006893f7, DAT_0069c67c==0, a per-light 'already drawn' latch DAT_006e0a68==0, DAT_007c118c >= 0xffff0104, object float 0x290>0 and flag word 0x27c bit2; looks up the DAT_0069d950/0x970 technique table and ends with the same Begin/DrawPrimitive/End (vtable+0x100/0x104/0x108) loop calling chimera__rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices2 seen in 0x520970/0x521900.
results.summary: Draws an additional (higher pixel-shader tier) dynamic-light contribution pass over an object's parts when that light has not already rendered this frame.

results.name: rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_new
results.evidence: Allocates a transparent-geometry-group record (0xa8-byte pooled slots, capped at DAT_0071d154<0x180, or the single static DAT_006e0a70 record when the queue-bit param_10&2 is set), fills it from the call parameters (bounds, blend/texture indices, a camera-facing tint from the DAT_007c1234/1238/123c axis dot product), allocates scratch memory via chimera__rasterizer_memory_alloc, then submits it via chimera__transparent_geometry_group_draw either immediately (object type 8 with flag bit3) or when the queue bit is set.
results.summary: Builds and submits a pooled transparent-geometry-group record (decal/particle style) with its blend, texture and camera-facing tint parameters.

results.name: chimera__registry_check_4
results.evidence: References the literal strings "-nogamma", "Software\\Microsoft\\Microsoft Games\\Halo" and "gamma"; scans the command line for -nogamma, reads/writes the "gamma" registry value via RegOpenKeyExA/RegQueryValueExA/RegCreateKeyExA/RegSetValueExA, and captures the current ramp with GetDC/GetDeviceGammaRamp/ReleaseDC.
results.summary: Checks the -nogamma command-line flag and the registry gamma setting, captures the current display gamma ramp (or a linear default), and persists the gamma registry flag.

results.name: chimera__registry_check_3
results.evidence: References "Software\\Microsoft\\Microsoft Games\\Halo" and "gamma"; restores a previously captured gamma ramp through the D3D device (vtable+0x54) or GDI SetDeviceGammaRamp, then writes the "gamma" registry value back to 0, using the flags set up by chimera__registry_check_4.
results.summary: Restores the display gamma ramp saved earlier and resets the gamma registry marker, mirroring chimera__registry_check_4's setup.

results.name: chimera__gamma
results.evidence: Computes a log2/power-curve gamma ramp from DAT_0071d1e0 into the DAT_006e11xx/13xx/15xx tables (via FUN_006283c0/FUN_006391b4) and applies it through the D3D device (vtable+0x54) or GDI SetDeviceGammaRamp, matching the ramp consumed by chimera__registry_check_3/4.
results.summary: Rebuilds and applies the game's gamma-correction ramp to the display or Direct3D device.

results.name: rasterizer_gamma_compute_brightness
results.evidence: Computes a log2/f2xm1/fscale power-curve exponent from a brightness value at in_EAX+0x100 (via FUN_006391b4), clamps it to [1,0xfe] and stores it to DAT_0071d1e0/DAT_0071d1e4, the exponent later consumed by chimera__gamma's ramp construction.
results.summary: Converts a stored brightness setting into the exponent used to build the display gamma ramp.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_new
results.evidence: Looks up a material/shader index for the decal via the DAT_006d99d8 material table, selects a texture with chimera__rasterizer_set_texture, sets a fixed sequence of texture-stage combiner states across 3 stages, and finishes with chimera__rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_draw_vertices(0); installed as one of the 'new' decal renderers by 0x523ec0.
results.summary: Draws a decal using a material-selected texture and a fixed multitexture combiner setup, for the post-1.1 capability path.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_new_shaded
results.evidence: Same material-index lookup (DAT_006d99d8) and chimera__rasterizer_set_texture/chimera__rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_draw_vertices pattern as 0x522930, but additionally builds per-vertex/normal data from the object's part geometry and an ambient-light dot product (DAT_007c1234/1238/123c); called by 0x523b90 for material index 4.
results.summary: Draws a lit/shaded variant of the decal-rendering path used for the post-1.1 capability path.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_new_multi
results.evidence: Uses the DAT_0069e1b0 device-like interface's Begin/DrawPrimitive/End (vtable+0x100/0x104/0x108) to iterate multiple decal instances, selecting textures via chimera__rasterizer_set_texture and finishing each with chimera__rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_draw_vertices; called by 0x523d10 for material index 4.
results.summary: Draws a batch of decal instances through a dedicated draw interface, for the post-1.1 capability path.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_old
results.evidence: Delegates to rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_new (FUN_00522930) when the material index from DAT_006d99d8 equals 4, otherwise draws directly with a simpler 2-stage texture combiner and chimera__rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_draw_vertices(0); installed as one of the 'old' decal renderers by 0x523ec0.
results.summary: Draws a decal using a simplified combiner setup for the pre-1.1 capability path, falling back to the newer renderer for material index 4.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_old_shaded
results.evidence: Delegates to rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_new_shaded (FUN_00522c60) for material index 4, otherwise draws with a fixed 0x3cffffff alpha/texture-stage setup; the pre-1.1 counterpart selected by 0x523ec0.
results.summary: Draws the lit decal variant for the pre-1.1 capability path, delegating to the newer shaded renderer for material index 4.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_old_multi
results.evidence: Delegates to rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_new (FUN_00523690) for material index 4, otherwise drives the DAT_0069e1b0 draw interface directly; the pre-1.1 counterpart selected by 0x523ec0.
results.summary: Draws a batch of decal instances for the pre-1.1 capability path, delegating to the newer multi-instance renderer for material index 4.

results.name: rasterizer_decal_select_draw_functions
results.evidence: Installs DAT_007c0480/0x484/0x488 with either {rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_old_multi, rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_old, rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_old_shaded} or {rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_new_multi, rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_new, rasterizer_decal_draw_variant_new_shaded} depending on DAT_007c118c < 0xffff0101.
results.summary: Chooses the pre- or post-1.1 pixel-shader-capability set of decal-drawing function pointers.

results.name: rasterizer_bitmap_compute_mipmap_skip_count
results.evidence: Clamps DAT_0068944e (a texture-quality/reduction setting) to [0,2] and, while the reduced width/height stay >= 64px, repeatedly halves the caller's width/height pointers, returning the number of top mip levels actually skipped; consumed by the bitmap-lock/upload helpers 0x523fa0/0x524100/0x524270/0x5243c0.
results.summary: Computes how many top mip levels to drop from a bitmap based on the texture-quality setting, halving the reported width/height accordingly.

results.name: rasterizer_bitmap_lock_surface
results.evidence: Dispatches on a resource-type field (offset 0xc/0xa of the bitmap record) to IDirect3DTexture9::LockRect (device vtable+0x5c), IDirect3DCubeTexture9::LockRect (vtable+0x60) or IDirect3DVolumeTexture9::LockBox (vtable+0x64... offset 100), using the mip-skip count from rasterizer_bitmap_compute_mipmap_skip_count and capability flags from DAT_007c10fc.
results.summary: Locks the appropriate Direct3D surface/volume/cube-face for a bitmap resource, honoring the current mip-skip level and capability flags.

results.name: rasterizer_bitmap_upload_2d_mipmaps
results.evidence: Loops per mip level, locking the destination surface (param_1+0x28, vtable+0x4c/+0x50), obtaining the source pixel pointer via FUN_0043fb20 and copying rows using pitch/row-size helpers FUN_0043fbb0/FUN_0043fce0 or a single full-size copy via FUN_0043fcb0, using rasterizer_bitmap_compute_mipmap_skip_count for the starting level.
results.summary: Uploads a packed 2D bitmap's mip chain into a locked Direct3D texture, level by level.

results.name: rasterizer_bitmap_upload_cubemap_mipmaps
results.evidence: Same lock/copy pattern as rasterizer_bitmap_upload_2d_mipmaps but iterates cube faces via FUN_0043fbe0/FUN_0043fc10 and a per-material size table (DAT_006571f4), gated by a capability flag in DAT_007c10fc.
results.summary: Uploads a packed cubemap bitmap's mip chain into a locked Direct3D cube texture, face by face.

results.name: rasterizer_bitmap_upload_cubemap_all_faces
results.evidence: Iterates all 6 cube faces (using the DAT_0065e088 face-order table) inside the mip-level loop and divides the computed row size by 6, unlike rasterizer_bitmap_upload_cubemap_mipmaps which loops faces outside the level loop; shares the same FUN_0043fa90/FUN_0043fbb0/FUN_0043fc10/FUN_0043fce0 helpers.
results.summary: Uploads all six faces of a packed cubemap bitmap for each mip level, an alternate iteration order to rasterizer_bitmap_upload_cubemap_mipmaps.

results.name: rasterizer_bitmap_sample_texel
results.evidence: Computes wrapped u/v texel indices (power-of-two AND-mask or modulo) from normalized UVs and a mip bias, then decodes the pixel per stored format via a switch on cases 6/8/9/10/11 (RGB565, ARGB1555/4444, 32-bit, 8-bit indexed), unpacking each into a 32-bit ARGB-style value.
results.summary: Samples a single texel from a locked bitmap surface at the given UV, decoding whichever pixel format the bitmap uses.

results.name: rasterizer_vertex_buffer_create
results.evidence: Allocates a vertex buffer through FUN_00530570 sized/typed from the DAT_006e1a94[param_2*3] table, Locks it (device vtable+0x2c), remaps the source vertex stream into the destination declaration with special-case field reordering for declaration ids 0xc/0xd/0x13 (skinned/lit layouts), Unlocks it (vtable+0x30) and writes the declaration id/pointer/count into the caller's handle struct.
results.summary: Creates a Direct3D vertex buffer for a given vertex declaration and fills it by reformatting the caller's source vertex data.

results.name: rasterizer_index_buffer_create
results.evidence: Computes the index-buffer byte size from a count and a type selector (in_DX: 0=triangle-list sized *6, 1=strip-like sized *2+4), creates it via device vtable+0x6c (CreateIndexBuffer), copies from a fixed source table, calls vtable+0x30 (Unlock), and zero-fills the output handle on any failure.
results.summary: Creates and fills a Direct3D index buffer of the requested primitive layout and size.

results.name: rasterizer_light_shadow_project_point
results.evidence: Transforms a world point with matrix4x3_transform_point using the matrix at DAT_007c128c, then applies a perspective-style divide against the projection constants at DAT_007c13c0-0x13fc, writing screen-space xy/depth to param_3 and a 2-component scale to param_4; used by rasterizer_light_shadow_render.
results.summary: Projects a world-space point and radius into screen space for the projected dynamic-light/shadow renderer.

results.name: rasterizer_light_shadow_render_target_begin
results.evidence: Gated on DAT_0069dd90 != 0; configures a run of SetRenderState/SetTextureStageState/SetSamplerState calls and binds a render target/texture selected by index (matches the render-target pool indices used in rasterizer_render_target_set_active); called with indices 6 and 7 from rasterizer_light_shadow_render.
results.summary: Prepares one of the two off-screen render targets used to build a projected dynamic-light's shadow silhouette.

results.name: rasterizer_light_shadow_render_target_composite
results.evidence: Takes two render-target indices and an object count (param_3), sets an extended render/texture-stage-state block, and iterates param_3 shadow casters, drawing/copying between the two buffers prepared by rasterizer_light_shadow_render_target_begin; called as FUN_00525720(6,7,count) from rasterizer_light_shadow_render.
results.summary: Renders shadow-caster geometry into and composites the two shadow render targets prepared for a projected dynamic light.

results.name: rasterizer_light_shadow_render
results.evidence: Computes a spotlight-style cone falloff using cos(45 degrees) against the object-to-light direction and world axes (DAT_007c1234/1238/123c), projects the light with rasterizer_light_shadow_project_point, and when DAT_0069ddb0 (a shadow-caster count) is non-zero drives rasterizer_light_shadow_render_target_begin(6)/(7) and rasterizer_light_shadow_render_target_composite(6,7,...) to build and composite the shadow buffers onto the scene.
results.summary: Top-level renderer for a projected dynamic light with real-time shadowing: computes the spotlight cone falloff, projects the light, and drives the two-pass shadow-buffer render when there are shadow casters.

results.name: rasterizer_light_disable_all
results.evidence: Gated on DAT_007c118c < 0xffff0101 (pre-1.1 fixed-function path) and DAT_007c1160 != 0; sets a default material (device vtable+0xc4, SetMaterial with &DAT_0069c708) then calls LightEnable(index,false) (vtable+0xd4) for every index up to DAT_007c1160, resetting DAT_007c3084.
results.summary: Resets the default material and disables every fixed-function Direct3D light for the pre-pixel-shader lighting fallback.

results.name: rasterizer_light_set
results.evidence: Builds a D3DLIGHT9-style descriptor (position, direction/attenuation scaled by 10.0/2.5, alpha 0.7) from a game light record (unaff_ESI), handling both a plain point light (offset 0x70==-1) and a light with a gel/cookie shader (computing an offset direction via vector3d_cross_product/normalize when flag bit 0x10 is set), then calls SetLight (vtable+0xcc) and LightEnable(index,true) (vtable+0xd4), incrementing DAT_007c3084.
results.summary: Populates and enables one fixed-function Direct3D light from a game light object, for the pre-pixel-shader lighting fallback.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_build_technique_table
results.evidence: Formats the literal technique-name strings "EnvironmentNo%s", "SelfIllumination%s", "ChangeColor%s", "Multipurpose%s", "Reflection%s" together with the shader_environment sub-option name table (s_MaskDetailBeforeReflectionBiased...) and resolves each combination via FUN_00530120 into the technique-id arrays DAT_006e17f4/0x18d8/0x19d0/0x1780/0x1968, using fewer combinations when DAT_007c118c < 0xffff0104.
results.summary: Builds the lookup tables of named shader techniques for the shader_environment reflection/self-illumination/change-color/multipurpose/detail options.

results.name: chimera__rasterizer_set_up_node_parts
results.evidence: Gathers per-node bone-transform rows (12 dwords each) from the DAT_007c04e0.. tables indexed by node-index bytes read from a bone buffer, packs up to 0x16 nodes into a local buffer, records the source/count into DAT_0071d19c/0x1a0, then calls device vtable+0x178 (SetVertexShaderConstantF-style) at register 0x1d with count iVar5*3 dwords.
results.summary: Uploads a model's per-node skeleton transforms as vertex-shader constants for hardware skinning.

results.name: rasterizer_model_set_render_states
results.evidence: Sets a fixed sequence of texture-stage/sampler states (D3DTSS_TEXCOORDINDEX-style) for stages 1-3, and when DAT_006893ec (model skinning enabled) is set, conditionally sets the frustum z-clip function (chimera__rasterizer_set_frustum_z_func) and calls chimera__rasterizer_set_model_skinning/FUN_00518ce0.
results.summary: Configures the fixed-function texture-coordinate and skinning render states used before drawing model geometry.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_select_technique_texture
results.evidence: Switches on a shader_environment map-type field (offset 0xd6) to pick among the reflection/self-illumination/change-color/multipurpose texture-id arrays (DAT_0069e330/0x2b0/0x2d0/0x2f0), matching the exact technique categories built by rasterizer_shader_environment_build_technique_table, and validates the choice via a device call (vtable+0xec) before returning the array pointer.
results.summary: Selects and validates the appropriate cached shader_environment technique texture array for an object's map type.

results.name: rasterizer_light_shadow_bind_render_target
results.evidence: Minimal helper switching which color/depth-stencil buffer is bound (device vtable+0x170/0x15c) depending on bit 0x200 of a flags word, optionally calling FUN_0051c790 before finishing with FUN_0051c730 in both branches.
results.summary: Binds either the main or an auxiliary render-target/depth-stencil pair depending on a caller flag.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_draw_singletexture
results.evidence: Selected as DAT_007c0474 by rasterizer_shader_environment_select_draw_functions when DAT_007c117c < 2 (fewest simultaneous texture stages); sets a small render-state block, calls FUN_005194e0/FUN_00519580 depending on object flag bit 3 (offset 0x28), and calls chimera__shader_texture_animation_evaluate.
results.summary: Draws a shader_environment surface using the lowest-capability, single/limited-texture-stage rendering path.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_draw_fixedfunction
results.evidence: Selected as DAT_007c0474 by rasterizer_shader_environment_select_draw_functions when DAT_007c118c < 0xffff0101 (no usable pixel shader); configures a larger fixed-function multitexture render-state block, calls color_rgb_float_to_int and chimera__shader_texture_animation_evaluate, then draws.
results.summary: Draws a shader_environment surface using the fixed-function multitexture path for devices without an adequate pixel shader.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_draw_pixelshader
results.evidence: Selected as DAT_007c0474 by rasterizer_shader_environment_select_draw_functions for DAT_007c118c >= 0xffff0101; obtains the technique texture from rasterizer_shader_environment_select_technique_texture, evaluates self-illumination animation via periodic_function_evaluate and chimera__shader_texture_animation_evaluate, blends environment-map/fog tint using the DAT_007c1408-0x1440 constant block, and draws with chimera__rasterizer_draw_dynamic_triangles_static_vertices.
results.summary: Draws a shader_environment surface using the full pixel-shader path, including animated self-illumination and environment-map/fog tinting.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_draw
results.evidence: Gated by DAT_006893ec (shader_environment master enable); optionally builds a deferred draw record via rasterizer_shader_environment_group_new when a lightmap/vertex condition holds, then invokes whichever renderer rasterizer_shader_environment_select_draw_functions installed at DAT_007c0470/0x474, choosing between them based on DAT_0071d1f8.
results.summary: Top-level entry point that dispatches shader_environment rendering for one object part to the capability-appropriate renderer.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_group_new
results.evidence: Copies shader/render-state fields from the active object (DAT_0071d1f0) into a newly allocated record, choosing a cached-vertex path (FUN_00515260) versus a fresh-geometry path (FUN_00515230), mirroring the allocation pattern of rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_new.
results.summary: Builds a deferred shader_environment draw record for an object part, to be submitted through the transparent-geometry pipeline.

results.name: rasterizer_model_draw_environment_shader_environment
results.evidence: Populates a local draw-parameters struct with camera-relative fog terms (DAT_007c1234/1238/123c dot products) and object fields, then either calls chimera__transparent_geometry_group_draw immediately when a flag bit is set, or caches allocations from chimera__rasterizer_memory_alloc into the static DAT_006e18d4/0x17e0/0x18d0 buffers for reuse; matches its existing descriptive name.
results.summary: Prepares and submits (or caches) the parameters needed to draw one object's shader_environment surface.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_draw_end
results.evidence: Gated by DAT_006893ec; restores the frustum z-clip function via chimera__rasterizer_set_frustum_z_func/FUN_00519200 when needed, optionally uploads an identity-like vertex-shader constant block (device vtable+0xb0, register 0x100) for the pre-1.1 fog path, and clears the active-object pointer DAT_0071d1f0.
results.summary: Performs end-of-pass cleanup for the shader_environment renderer, restoring shared render state and clearing the active-object pointer.

results.name: rasterizer_shader_environment_select_draw_functions
results.evidence: Installs the (DAT_007c0470, DAT_007c0474) function-pointer pair to one of {rasterizer_shader_environment_draw_singletexture, rasterizer_shader_environment_draw_fixedfunction, rasterizer_shader_environment_draw_pixelshader} based on DAT_007c117c (texture-stage count) and DAT_007c118c (pixel-shader version).
results.summary: Chooses which shader_environment rendering implementation to use based on the device's texture-stage and pixel-shader capabilities.

results.name: rasterizer_debug_overlay_initialize
results.evidence: Gated by DAT_0069c689==0 && DAT_00689403!=0; probes device format support twice via FUN_00444550, creates/locks an off-screen surface, sets DAT_0069d350=5 and DAT_0071d205=1, and configures the same alpha-blended textured-quad render-state block used by rasterizer_debug_draw_quad_small/large.
results.summary: Sets up the off-screen surface and render states used by the developer-flag-gated debug quad drawing routines.

results.name: rasterizer_debug_draw_quad_small
results.evidence: Gated by DAT_00689403 && DAT_0071d205 (set up by rasterizer_debug_overlay_initialize); builds a small colored quad of half-size param_2*0.0625 around a 2D point, colors it via FUN_006391b4, and submits it with device vtable+0x14c (DrawPrimitiveUP, 6 vertices).
results.summary: Draws a small colored debug marker quad centered on a screen-space point, when the debug overlay is enabled.

results.name: rasterizer_debug_draw_quad_large
results.evidence: Same DAT_00689403/DAT_0071d205 gating and DrawPrimitiveUP quad pattern as rasterizer_debug_draw_quad_small, but uses a larger fixed 32/42-pixel half-size (varying with DAT_0087a478+0xc), configures two texture stages via chimera__rasterizer_set_texture, and calls rasterizer_render_target_set_active first.
results.summary: Draws a larger textured debug marker quad after switching to an auxiliary render target, when the debug overlay is enabled.

results.name: rasterizer_light_volume_draw
results.evidence: Gated by DAT_00689423; sets two textures via chimera__rasterizer_set_texture and an extended texture-stage-state block, linearly interpolates two RGB color endpoints (object offsets 0x60-0x7c) by a distance-based factor, uploads the result as vertex-shader constants, and draws through the DAT_0069d990 interface with chimera__rasterizer_transparent_geometry_group_draw_vertices.
results.summary: Renders a color-gradient light-glow/volume effect between two colors, blended by distance and drawn as transparent geometry.

results.name: rasterizer_render_target_initialize
results.evidence: Queries/creates two device render-target-related objects (vtable+0x98/+0x30 on DAT_0069d364/0x378), populates a pixel-format/pitch table (DAT_0069d358..), branching on DAT_0069c68a, then iterates the DAT_0069d374.. surface-descriptor array creating textures (vtable+0x5c) and surface levels (vtable+0x48) for entries not yet created, finally creating a vertex declaration (FUN_0057ea70) and a vertex buffer sized by FUN_00583b17(0x144) via device vtable+0x68.
results.summary: Creates the pool of off-screen render-target textures/surfaces and the supporting vertex declaration/buffer used by the rasterizer's auxiliary render passes.

results.name: rasterizer_render_target_shutdown
results.evidence: Releases (vtable+8) each paired surface/texture entry across the DAT_0069d368.. table and the two device objects DAT_0071d208/0x20c, resetting DAT_0069d350 to 0xffff (invalid render-target index); tears down the pool built by rasterizer_render_target_initialize.
results.summary: Releases the off-screen render-target pool and supporting device objects created by rasterizer_render_target_initialize.

results.name: rasterizer_render_target_set_active
results.evidence: Given a render-target index in_AX (0..8), looks up the paired object from DAT_0069d364, calls device vtable+0x94 with it, records DAT_0069d350=in_AX, obtains a description via vtable+0x30 (except for index 1, which uses a cached size), and calls vtable+0xbc/+0xac to bind/clear it.
results.summary: Switches the active off-screen render target used by the debug-overlay and dynamic-light-shadow drawing routines.

results.name: rasterizer_render_target_bind_as_texture
results.evidence: Looks up the texture object paired with render-target index in_AX from the DAT_0069d368 table and calls device vtable+0x104 (SetTexture) with stage index in_DX.
results.summary: Binds a previously rendered off-screen render target as a texture on the given sampler stage.

results.name: rasterizer_render_target_bind_pixel_shader_texture
results.evidence: Same DAT_0069d368 render-target-texture lookup as rasterizer_render_target_bind_as_texture, but instead calls an ID3DXConstantTable-style interface (vtable+0xd0, set-texture-by-handle) obtained from *in_EDX, passing the handle stored at in_EDX[param_1+2].
results.summary: Binds a render-target texture to a named pixel-shader constant/sampler handle instead of a raw device stage.
